post.description: Access15m, refresh family absolute7days. Web gets HttpOnly cookie and no JSON refresh; extension gets raw refresh only in trusted context. CORS/client origin pinned. This legacy web JSON credential transport does not by itself solve blocked third-party cookies; first-party broker/PKCE release gate remains open. A successful new web login atomically revokes all previous web sessions and their refresh families for this user. Extension sessions remain independent. Refresh and browser-code exchange reuse the existing session. All client types require a locally verified, unexpired single-use ALTCHA v2 proof before password hashing. Rejected proof: 422 invalid_captcha; verification storage unavailable: 503 captcha_unavailable. Fetch and solve a new challenge after any rejected attempt.

put.summary: Set or delete my review of a video
put.description: One review per author per video (plain text, 1..1000 characters after normalization: valid UTF-8, CRLF/CR as LF, NFC, trimmed, no control characters except tab and line feed). text=null deletes the review. The revision keeps counting across delete and re-create (a delete returns revision n with text null; create again with expected_revision n). Same rules as state writes: exact retry with the same Idempotency-Key replays the stored result before lease/version checks; a fresh execution needs a valid X-Offline-Lease (410 reconcile_required) and the current revision (409 conflict). An unchanged command returns change_seq null. Other viewers read published, non-hidden reviews through GET /v1/users/{id}/recommendations when reviews_visibility admits them. Content policy v1: new review text cannot contain recognized links or listed RU/EN insults. HTTP422 review_links_not_allowed / review_abusive_language; rejected writes change no carrier/revision/sync/receipt. Old exact receipts stay replayable without reapplying a write.
